column1: # The checks tools/check runs (tools/check --help). One row per check, tab-separated:
#   name     unique; `{crate}` makes one check per crate of the srp-026g workspace
#   inputs   space-separated repo paths with globs (`**` any depth, `dir/**` everything under dir,
#            `*` within a name, `!glob` leaves files out); `{crate_inputs}` a crate's own folder,
#            its path dependencies' folders (transitively) and the files outside them its sources
#            include (include_str!/include_bytes!, CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR paths); `{main}/...` a file
#            of the main checkout (private/: not in the diff, but in the key), e.g. a toolchain pin
#   command  bash, run from the repo root; $CHECK_WORK is a new folder (kept when the check fails),
#            python3 and $PYTHON are tools/check's Python; the dev shell is `nix develop ./srp-026g`
#   notes    optional
# A check runs when a file its inputs match differs from the merge-base with origin/main, unless it
# passed on exactly these inputs (and this row) before. The inputs are everything the check reads:
# a file left out is a change the cache will not see.
# A row whose command is `-` adds inputs to the check of that name (what a scan cannot see).
# The `ignore` row: changed files no check needs to cover (they are not reported as not covered).
# Not covered yet: the exe patches' self-tests and Unicorn checks (srp-026g/client-patches: they
# need the original exe and a patch-by-patch map of inputs), the other Ruffle harnesses of
# srp-026g/scripts/*/check.sh, the map editor and the resource porter.
